children: Swedish voters head to the polls on Sunday, and while the left-wing opposition party looks to have a slight lead, there is no doubt that the momentum has turned in favor of the incumbent center-right bloc lately, SEB senior economist Johan Javeus writes. "The latest poll gives the opposition a lead of 2.6 percentage points, but that difference is within the statistical margin of error." Javeus notes that on election night in 2022, exit polls pointed to victory for the left, but then things slowly swung during the night in favor of the center-right parties and the election was not completely decided until all votes had been counted a few days later.
